name: Leica Q
description: Leica Q 数码相机。技术参数依据厂家规格表或官方说明书整理，具体模式及测试条件可通过逐项来源查阅。

rows.label: 传感器类型与像素
rows.value: CMOS 传感器；总像素 2630 万，有效像素 2420 万
rows.originalValue: CMOS 传感器, 26.3/24.2 百万像素 (总像素/有效像素)

rows.label: 色彩深度
rows.originalValue: 14 bit

rows.label: DNG / JPEG 分辨率
rows.originalValue: Focal length 28 mm: mega像素 (6000 × 4000 像素), mega像素 (4272 × 2848 像素), mega像素 (2976 × 1984 像素), mega像素 (1600 × 1080 像素). Focal length 35 mm: mega像素 (4800 × 3200 像素), mega像素 (3424 × 2288 像素), mega像素 (2384 × 1592 像素), mega像素 (1280 × 856 像素). Focal length 50 mm: mega像素 (3360 × 2240 像素), mega像素 (2400 × 1600 像素), mega像素 (1680 × 1120 像素), mega像素 (896 × 600 像素)

rows.label: 色彩空间
rows.value: 照片可选 sRGB、Adobe RGB、ECI RGB；视频为 sRGB
rows.originalValue: Selectable for photos: sRGB, Adobe® RGB, ECI RGB, for videos: sRGB

rows.label: 镜头系统
rows.value: Leica Summilux 28 mm f/1.7 ASPH.；9 组 11 片，含 3 片非球面镜片
rows.originalValue: Leica Summilux 28 mm f/1.7 ASPH., 11 elements in 9 groups, 3 aspherical elements

rows.label: 防抖
rows.value: 照片和视频均支持光学防抖
rows.originalValue: Optical compensation system for photo and video recordings

rows.label: 光圈范围
rows.originalValue: 1.7 to 16 in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 对焦距离
rows.originalValue: 30 cm to ∞, with macro setting from 17 cm

rows.label: 对焦方式
rows.value: 自动或手动对焦；手动对焦可启用放大和峰值辅助
rows.originalValue: Automatic (autofocus) or manual focusing, option of magnifying function and edge marking (focus peaking) available for manual setting

rows.label: 自动对焦系统
rows.originalValue: Contrast-based autofocus system

rows.label: 自动对焦模式
rows.value: AFS（合焦后释放快门）、AFC（随时可释放快门）；可保存自动对焦设置
rows.originalValue: AFS (shutter release only after successful focusing), AFC (shutter release possible at any time), AF setting can be saved

rows.label: 自动对焦测量方式
rows.value: 单区（可移动）、多区（49 区）、人脸识别、主体追踪；可选对焦设置／快门释放操作
rows.originalValue: Single zone (adjustable), multi-field (49 zones), face recognition, subject tracking, optional setting/shutter release

rows.label: 取景器
rows.value: LCOS 电子取景器，1280×960 像素×3 色（约 368 万点），4:3；屈光度 ±3；眼传感器自动切换取景器和显示屏
rows.originalValue: Electronic LCOS display, resolution: 1280 × 960 像素 x 3 colors (=3,68 MP), aspect ratio: 4:3, eyepiece: ±3 diopters, with eye sensor for automatic switching between viewfinder and monitor

rows.label: 显示屏
rows.value: 3 英寸 TFT 液晶触摸屏，约 104 万像素
rows.originalValue: 3" TFT LCD monitor with 约 1,040,000 像素, touch control possible

rows.label: ISO 范围
rows.originalValue: Automatic, ISO 100 to ISO 50000

rows.label: 白平衡
rows.value: 自动；日光、阴天、卤素灯、阴影、电子闪光预设；两组手动测量设置；手动色温
rows.originalValue: Automatic, default settings for: daylight, cloudy, halogen lighting, shadow, electronic flash, two manual settings with measuring, manual color temperature setting

rows.label: 曝光模式
rows.value: 程序自动、光圈优先、快门优先、手动曝光
rows.originalValue: Automatic program, aperture priority, shutter speed priority and manual setting

rows.label: 测光
rows.originalValue: Multi-field, center-weighted, spot

rows.label: 曝光补偿
rows.originalValue: ±3 EV in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 自动包围曝光
rows.value: 3 张，间隔最高 3 EV，1/3 EV 步长
rows.originalValue: Three exposures in graduations of up to 3 EV, can be set in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 快门类型
rows.originalValue: Mechanical and electronical

rows.label: 快门速度
rows.originalValue: 30 s to 1⁄2000 s with mech. Shutter 1⁄2500 s to 1⁄16000 s with electr. shutter, in 1⁄3 increments, flash synchronization up to 1⁄500 s

rows.label: 相机类型
rows.originalValue: Digital 35 mm compact camera

rows.label: 动态范围
rows.originalValue: 13 aperture stops

rows.label: 照片格式
rows.originalValue: Selectable: DNG + JPEG, JPEG

rows.label: 图像锐度 / 饱和度 / 对比度
rows.value: 锐度、饱和度、对比度各可调 5 挡；饱和度另有可选设置
rows.originalValue: Each selectable in 5 steps, also available as option in saturation

rows.label: 场景模式
rows.value: 全自动、运动、人像、风景、夜景人像、雪景／海滩、烛光、日落、望远镜摄影、微缩效果、全景、延时摄影
rows.originalValue: Fully automatic, sport, portrait, landscape, night portrait, snow/beach, candlelight, sunset, digiscoping, miniature effect, panorama, time lapse

rows.label: 连拍速度
rows.value: 可选 10／5／3 张/秒（高／中／低速）
rows.originalValue: Selectable: 10/5/3 fps (H/M/L)

rows.label: 自拍定时
rows.originalValue: Delay time either 2 s or 12 s

rows.label: 存储介质
rows.value: SD/SDHC/SDXC, 多媒体存储卡, 速度等级: UHS-1
rows.originalValue: SD/SDHC/SDXC, multimedia cards, speed class: UHS-1

rows.label: 无线网络
rows.value: IEEE 802.11b/g/n 无线局域网；1–11 信道；WPA／WPA2 加密；基础设施模式
rows.originalValue: Satisfies IEEE 802.11b/g/n standard (standard WLAN protocol), channel 1-11, encryption method: WLAN-compatible WPA™/ WPA2™, access method: infrastructure mode

rows.label: 近场通信 NFC
rows.originalValue: According to JIS X 6319-4 standard/13.56 MHz

rows.label: 连接接口
rows.originalValue: Micro USB socket (2.0), HDMI socket

rows.label: 电池与供电
rows.value: Leica BP-DC12 锂离子电池，额定直流 7.2V，1200mAh
rows.originalValue: Leica BP-DC12 lithium ion battery, rated voltage 7.2V DC, capacity: 1200 mAh
